svg.title: U-CODE framework, official pipeline overview
svg.desc: Six-stage policy pipeline from issue and repository inputs to generated and verified code, uncertainty estimates, bounded evidence search, controlled execution, and risk-gated release. A separate four-stage independent evaluation lane preserves a sealed oracle; a return arrow runs from controlled execution to search.
svg.text: Uncertainty-guided search for reliable AI-generated software
Principles • budget-matched comparisons • oracle isolation • source provenance • reproducibility • multi-model analysis
